COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
WPSS No. 2111 of 2019
With
WPSS No. 2112 of 2019
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. S.K. Mandal, learned counsel 
for the petitioner.
2. Mr. R.C. Joshi, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State.
3. Mr. T.A. Khan, learned Senior 
Advocate assisted by Mr. Shravan 
Pandey, learned counsel for respondent 
nos. 2 and 3.
4. In both the petitions, the 
petitioners are claiming compassionate 
appointment on the ground that their
husband who was serving in sugar 
factory as daily wagers since 1989,
without any break, died in harness. 
5. It is submitted that after death of 
the husbands of the petitioners, 
respondent offered appointment to 
both the petitioners on contractual 
basis on consolidated salary and since 
then they are continuing. 
6. Mr. T.A. Khan, learned Senior 
Advocate for the respondents seeks 
time to verify whether there was any
break in service of the deceased 
employee. 
7. Put up this mater for final disposal 
on 25.11.2024 immediately after fresh.
8. In the meantime, since the 
petitioners are serving as sweepers,  the respondents are directed either to 
pay regular pay as attached to the post 
of the sweeper or to show cause on the 
date fixed.
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 17.10.2024
Parul

In

Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. S.K.Mandal, learned counsel for 
the applicant.
2. Mr. Himanshu Sain, learned Brief 
Holder for the State.
3. Mr. T.A. Khan, learned Senior Counsel 
assisted by Mr. Vinay Bhatt learned counsel 
for respondent no. 2 and 3.
4. Heard on Correction Applications
(MCRC No.13642 of 2025 and 13643 of 
2025). 
4. Correction Applications, MCRC 
No.13642 of 2025 and 13643 of 2025, have
been moved by the applicant seeking
correction in the order dated 17.10.2024, 
particularly in para no.8.
5. For the reasons stated in the 
correction application both the Correction 
Applications (MCRC No.13642 of 2025 and 
13643 of 2025) are allowed.
6. Let in the order dated 17.10.2024, in 
para No. 8 word “Sweeper” be read as word 
“Class IV employee”.
7. This order shall also be treated part of 
the order dated 17.10.2024.
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) 
03.01.2026
Nahid
